content.statement: The current returns policy v2 explicitly sets the standard-item full-refund window at 30 days, matching the claimed current window.
content.plan: Extracted day counts from policy_docs and base_retrieval, compared the current v2 value to the claimed 30-day value and to the stale v1/judge reference 14-day value, and checked the 10-day order age against both windows.

evidence.test: deterministic policy-day consistency check; two-sample t-test not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields are present
evidence.defect_signal: base_retrieval contains only the stale 14-day v1 policy while policy_docs contains the current 30-day v2 policy, and base_judge_reference_days is 14.
